title: Kiddie Casserole with Polish Sausage and Cod
description: A kid-friendly casserole with polish sausage and cod, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This hearty dish is a great way to get the whole family to eat together.

ingredients.name: Casserole
ingredients.notes: for the base of the dish

instructions: Cook the polish sausage in a pan over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cream of mushroom soup and milk to the pan and stir until combined.
Cut the cod fish into 1-inch pieces and add it to the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the casserole base to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the polish sausage and cod mixture over the casserole base.
Sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
